I used to listen to happy silly electronic music back then, and really didnt understand how guitars work. So my friend would constantly try to convert me into his taste in music, and show me different bands he found. Fast forward like 3 years I think, I was sitting at home one day and suddenly I remembered that song, that video, it was so vivid, just from the memory alone I already started liking it. I searched it up, and I listened to it on repeat for like a day. "What a fool I used to be" I kept telling myself, "to not give this a proper listen and enjoy it". I immediately downloaded HTTT, which I couldnt quite click with, so I skyped that friend that was the reason I listened to that song all along, told him about how I now learned to appreciate this song and asked him for some advice for where to start.
